encoding.notes: Hand-specified Print=0x0476, FFP literal=0x0046 and arithmetic=0xffec opcodes, big-endian literal words and line lengths. Independent of the production token table/encoder. FFP(bits) in source is descriptive notation rather than an implemented AMOS function.

evidence.notes: Expectations follow the preserved Motorola FFPDIV routine's exponent guards, high-word estimate, single correction, wrapped remainder and second high-word estimate. The fourth/fifth cases overflow the second 16-bit DIVU; the CPU leaves its cleared-low-word dividend unchanged, producing source-specific quotients. The final case underflows at the initial exponent guard. See NXP M68000PM for DIVU overflow behavior. These are source-analysis expectations, not captured execution of a particular AMOS/Kickstart version.
